photos.caption: Figure 3 identifies ripe Ofelia SO raspberry fruit. Low-resolution monochrome patent image; open the original document for detail.

names.portfolio_context: The original US grant identifies Ofelia SO; claim 1 is on PDF page 3, column 6. The company list uses Ofelia. Check the identity before joining those labels. The technical sheet and patent report different trial measurements; neither is an approved universal trait.
